preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 3000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and the maximum possible edges for n nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and 0 <= w <= 100000 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid nodes and have a weight between 0 and 100000.
The starting node must be a valid node number between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the total weight of the minimum spanning tree as a string.
The total weight must be the sum of the weights of the edges in the minimum spanning tree.
The number of edges in the minimum spanning tree must be n - 1.
